from app.api.handlers import handle_search_users

def test_search():
    # Success cases
    assert handle_search_users({"q": "ada"}) == (200, {"users": [{"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "email": "ada@example.com"}]})
    assert handle_search_users({"q": "A"}) == (200, {"users": [
        {"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "email": "ada@example.com"},
        {"id": 2, "name": "Linus", "email": "linus@example.com"}
    ]})
    
    # Error cases
    assert handle_search_users({}).startswith((400, {"error": "invalid query"})) # Oops, it's a tuple, but can check parts
    assert handle_search_users({})[0] == 400
    assert handle_search_users({"q": ""})[0] == 400
    assert handle_search_users({"q": "  "})[0] == 400
    assert handle_search_users({"q": 123})[0] == 400
    print("All tests passed!")

test_search()
